`tap02_reference.py` is the TAP-02 reference implementation, copied unmodified from
[TapeOutProtocol/TAPs](https://github.com/TapeOutProtocol/TAPs) `assets/tap-02/reference.py` at commit `527477ecb7cf68ee9e86d8292669d57fe1680572`
(MIT, see the file header). It is the normative evaluator we check generated netlists against.
